title: observability: token+KV metrics & tracing dashboard + alert tuning
author: Evelyn Chen
release_notes: Added token- and KV-cache-level metrics and tracing spans, new Grafana dashboard panels, and tuned alert thresholds to reduce noise.
description: Motivation: reduce operational blind spots for token and KV-cache-level performance and cut alert noise from spiky token-cost signals. This PR adds fine-grained token-level and KV-cache-level observability (metrics + tracing), a unified Grafana dashboard with cost/latency breakdown panels, and updated alert thresholds and grouping rules. Changes include new prometheus exporters, tracing span additions around KV cache hits/misses and batching, dashboard JSON, alert rule updates, and docs/upgrade notes. Checklist: [x] add token and KV metrics (prometheus) [x] add tracing spans for KV and batch lifecycle [x] new Grafana panels for token cost, token latency, kv hit/miss, batching efficiency [x] update alert thresholds and grouping to reduce noise [x] integration tests for metrics labels and spans [x] docs/upgrade notes and migration steps.
commits: a1: export token-level counters and histograms (token_cost_total, token_latency_seconds, kv_cache_hit_total)
b2: add tracing spans around kv cache lookup + batch assembly (obs/tracing package)
c3: Grafana dashboard JSON + smaller panel layouts for per-model breakdowns
d4: prometheus alert rules tuning (reduce false positives, add grouping by model and route)
e5: integration tests for metrics labels and example dashboards
f6: docs: observability token-level metrics and migration notes
review_comments: Marco Diaz: Overall looks good. A few nit comments on metric cardinality and label naming (suggest removing raw route path and use route_id).
Evelyn Chen: Reply: switched route->route_id and added migration note in docs to advise users to switch their dashboards.
Samuel Ortiz: Can we ensure prometheus histograms use consistent buckets across models? Also please include an example PromQL for cost/latency P50/P95.
Evelyn Chen: Added consistent buckets and included example queries in dashboard JSON + docs.
Priya Kumar: Alert noise looks better after tuning but please test on staging with synthetic workload before rollout.
Evelyn Chen: Ran staging canary for 48h with synthetic traffic; attached results and lowered alert rate to 5m grouping.
notes_for_ops: Staging rollout: enable new metrics_exporter flag OBS_TOKEN_KV_METRICS=true and run for 48h to validate cardinality.
Prometheus: update scrape job to include /metrics?obs=token_kv on serving runtime (see deploy/helm/values.monitoring.yaml).
Grafana: import infra/monitoring/grafana/redwood-token-kv-dashboard.json to dashboards-managed folder; panels reference datasource 'prometheus'.
Alerts: token_latency_alerts.yaml and kv_cache_alerts.yaml should be applied with a 5m for 'for' window initially in prod to reduce noise; revisit after 2 weeks.
testing: Unit tests: metrics exporter label normalization, tracing span names — pass
Integration: synthetic traffic run in staging for 48h validating p50/p95 cost and KV hit-rate metrics — pass
E2E: dashboard import validation and promql queries smoke tests — pass
